assessment.label: looseness
assessment.reason: Query shows high 1x on all 4 channels 0.011-0.016, ruling out normal (~0.0003-0.0016) and misalignment (1x ~0.0003-0.0012, 2x-dominant). 1x dominance alone suggests unbalance vs looseness. Unlike unbalance references where 1x >>2x e.g. 0.0137 vs 0.0019, 0.0126 vs 0.0050, 0.0178 vs 0.0052, query has substantial harmonics: ch0 1x 0.0116, 2x 0.0089, 3x 0.0115 (1x/3x ~1.0) and ch2 1x 0.0159, 2x 0.0130, 3x 0.0032 (1x/2x ~1.2). This multi-harmonic elevation with 1x still high matches looseness references e.g. 1x 0.0075/2x 0.0077/3x 0.0048 and 1x 0.0142/2x 0.0131/3x 0.0242. Limitation: radial signals and one short recording cannot uniquely separate unbalance with secondary looseness, but harmonic pattern favors looseness over pure unbalance.

events.reason: Query ch0 shows high 1x (~0.0117) plus high 2x (~0.009) and 3x (~0.0115), above normal refs (1x <0.002).
